besluite.fout: 'Die meeste van die land' copies English 'most of the country' for a portion of one area.
besluite.rede: 'Die grootste deel van die land' is the idiomatic Afrikaans and keeps the same quantity, so the meaning is unchanged.
The original word order is natural Afrikaans; moving the time phrase first is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'Daar' follows a sentence about the desert, so a reader can take it to mean the settlements grew in the desert.
besluite.rede: 'In hierdie strook' points unambiguously back to the strip along the Nile, which is what the original meant.

besluite.fout: 'Daardie' is stiff and distancing for boats named in the sentence just before.
besluite.rede: The plain article reads naturally and refers to the same boats, so nothing moves.

besluite.fout: The chain 'groot en georganiseerde ... landbou en handel en ook 'n regering en godsdiens' is clumsy.
besluite.rede: A plain list with the same four items reads better, loses nothing, and matches the shared glossary definition of beskawing.
This is a glossary definition and 'die land rondom' is acceptable Afrikaans that is clear on its own, so there is no error a language agent may fix.
